facts.fact: 为向归来的Nate Yellow Tail隐瞒身份，Benjamin手按胸口自称“Bill, Bill Pratt”，刻意换成公路腔说话；Mooch一眼识破却笑着接戏，自报“Molly Spotted Elk”、又改口“Sacheen Littlefeather”。
facts.anchor: “Listen, I’m Bill, Bill Pratt,” Benjamin said, touching his chest with all five fingertips of his right hand—so earnest.

facts.fact: Benjamin从房车储物箱里取出Heavy Runner男孩的骨骸（肋骨、胫骨、尺骨、头骨），为保护头骨，他把头骨垫进Raggedy Ann布娃娃的布脸后面、眼位大致对齐，再用从娃娃胸腔圣经上抽走的皮绳绕娃娃布脖勒紧，防止头骨滑进身体，圣经本体被丢到脚踏板上。
facts.anchor: To keep the skull safe from the rest of the bones, he tucked it up behind the doll’s cloth face, the eyes mostly lining up, the leather string cinched around her fabric neck to keep the skull from sliding down into the body.

facts.fact: 骨骸主人是Heavy Runner男孩：他死时不到十岁（“从没来得及给任何人当祖先”），对Benjamin来说算隔了许多代的叔祖辈；男孩是在南达科他拜访时被抓走送寄宿学校的。
facts.anchor: Not Benjamin’s ancestor necessarily—he died before he was ten, never got to ancest anyone—but sort of like a many-times-great-uncle?

facts.fact: 附在Seine体内的东西用男性低沉嗓音（“Hello, my relative”）说话，Benjamin从腔调认出是Russell Means——即1989年参议院听证会上发表18分钟预备发言的那位AIM活动家；而Means已经死了。
facts.anchor: It was that same clipped-but-controlled delivery from the 1989 Senate hearings that he always showed class, to try to foment what might need fomenting.

facts.fact: 附身者借Seine之口自称是“在湖边出卖了你的那位表亲”，点明Seine是Benjamin的表亲、湖上弃他之事与她有关；Benjamin仍辩称“她不会出卖我，我是她表亲”，被讥讽“瘾君子也有原则吗”。
facts.anchor: “Your cousin who sold you out at the lake,” Seine said.

facts.fact: 为证明自己有能耐，附身者借Seine张开的嘴播出一则警用电台通讯：那辆“junky Indian RV”正向西行驶，Trooper Dane打算把它拦下做安全检查，看看车里有什么。
facts.anchor: To prove it, she opened her mouth and from that hollow space came a police radio squawking about some junky Indian RV headed west, and how Trooper Dane was going to pull it over for a safety check, see what he can find inside.

facts.fact: 附身者向Benjamin开价：交出他的两个女儿（连同离婚后归前妻抚养、他沦为周末父亲）换他“载入史册、被铭记、开启运动”；Benjamin答应，自我说服称“这是相容的，不是互斥的（inclusive, not exclusive）”。
facts.anchor: “It helps them too,” Benjamin said. “This is inclusive, not exclusive.”

facts.fact: Seine用全身重量硬撕粘在天花板上的掌皮——撕裂声如撕开一块生牛排，皮肉松脱后裸露的指骨迅速滑出，肘部撞上搁板，把污物溅到Benjamin脸上；随后又用同样方式撕脱了左手。
facts.anchor: Slowly, slowly, the sound wet and tearing like pulling an uncooked steak apart, the skin let loose of the hand, the wrist, at which point her raw, skeletal fingers slipped out fast, her elbow conking on the shelf, splashing muck into Benjamin’s face.
